headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 13, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 8 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs. In other action, the Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals 10-2, with Bryce Miller leading the way.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Coleman Crow, a right-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. Other players on the injured list include Chase Dollander (Colorado Rockies), Seth Lugo (Kansas City Royals), Brent Rooker (Athletics), Ramón Urías (St. Louis Cardinals), Adolis García (Philadelphia Phillies), Daulton Varsho (Toronto Blue Jays), and Javier Báez (Detroit Tigers).

The Cleveland Guardians made a roster move, trading RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations. The Philadelphia Phillies also made a trade, acquiring RF Derek Hill and other considerations from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. Additionally, the Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 8 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way for the Mariners, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Torkelson's Homer Not Enough as Tigers Fall to Guardians**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers came up short in a 2-3 loss to the Cleveland Guardians. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Coleman Crow Placed on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Coleman Crow has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to June 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cleveland Guardians Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations on June 11, 2026.
